# Climb batch 19: the repair after the merged-diff review

Written 2026-10-20 on `main` above `aa9632536`, the judge's ruling (`explorations/compile-ladder/climb-batch-19/JUDGE-review.md`). The repair carries out the ruling's eight steps in order, in `/home/user/fortress`, after the gate there had ended (no `ant` or `java` process left; its outputs under the gate's scratch folder last written at 03:14Z). Nothing under `ProjectFortress/` or `Library/` was edited, no test was added, and nothing was built or run but the specification and `record.py`.

## 1. What was done, by the ruling's steps

| step | done |
|---|---|
| 1 | Worked in the main tree after the gate, each call set up as `.claude/skills/fortress-repo/references/build-and-caches.md` says. |
| 2 | The ruling's eleven lines inserted in `Specification/appendices/changes.tex` after `:2873` ("code generator does not compile (row~787 of the revival's gap ledger).") and before the old `:2874` ("They also differ on a pair whose static parameters' bounds exclude each other, as"); the new sentence is `:2874-2884`, `tint`'s `:2885-2894`. No other line of the entry changed (`git diff --stat`: 11 insertions). Its citations checked against the tree: row 788 at `explorations/fortress-gap-ledger.md:385`; `explorations/compile-ladder/rung-existential-reduction/SKEPTIC.md:102`, "`generic` (loads)" and "Invalid overloading of g"; `ProjectFortress/tests/XXXGenericObjectInstanceBesidePlainWalk.fss:8-12`; `RECORD.md:30`; the Meet Rule at `Specification/advanced/overloading.tex:551-553`. |
| 3 | No new run, as the ruling says. |
| 4 | F-258's line copied to a scratch file, its sentence on the two paths' differences replaced by the ruling's, and written by `python3 explorations/coordinator/tools/record.py set F-258 <file> --from 'compile-ladder/climb-batch-19/JUDGE-review.md#The repair' --note 'row 788 named among the two paths differences, as in Appendix I'`: "F-258: rewritten", exit 0. `record.py` kept the old line in `explorations/coordinator/FACTS-history.md`, under `### F-258`, from "4. The repair". Its sentence's citations checked: `ProjectFortress/src/com/sun/fortress/interpreter/evaluator/types/FType.java:212-217` (`excludesOtherSimply`, "If neither type can be extended, then they exclude."), `ProjectFortress/src/com/sun/fortress/interpreter/evaluator/values/OverloadedFunction.java:420` (`ownPair`), `:439` (`coincide = ownPair && ...`) and `:467-479` (the withdrawal only under `ownPair`). |
| 5 | `RECORD.md`: `:23` with the ruling's sentence appended; `:88` `changes.tex:2882` made `:2893`, its `:2873` kept; `:155` `:2865-2883` made `:2865-2894`; the paragraph "**Corrections, after the review.**" after `:90` and before the heading of rung S. No other citation of `changes.tex` in `RECORD.md` is below `:2873` (`grep -n -o '28[0-9][0-9]\(-[0-9]*\)\?'`: the others are `:2845-2851`, `:2871-2873` and commit hashes). The rungs' `REPORT.md` and `SKEPTIC.md` are unchanged. |
| 6 | The specification built (below), with deviation 1. Then `git clean -fXq -- Specification`; `Specification/fortress.pdf` not updated. |
| 7 | `python3 explorations/coordinator/tools/record.py check --base 612869b4a2934caf40cd17a7afcf2ab149fc9252`: "record.py check: FACTS.md 196 entries, POSITIONS.md 83 entries; 0 failures; reported: size 2". |
| 8 | One local commit on `main`, not pushed; its paths in deviation 2. |

### The specification's build

`( cd Specification/fortress && ./ant genSource && ./ant tex )`, logged under the tree's `tmp/`: "BUILD SUCCESSFUL" / "Total time: 36 seconds", then "Output written on fortress.pdf (681 pages, 2347973 bytes)." / "BUILD SUCCESSFUL" / "Total time: 42 seconds". The rendered text (`pdftotext` of the built `fortress.pdf`) holds the new sentence: "The interpreter also reads an object type over a static parameter as excluding a type that the object type is at some instance of the static parameters, and so loads pairs that the Meet Rule refuses, ... and the compiled type checker refuses the pair (row 788".

## 2. Deviations

1. **Step 6's grep prints 41, not 0.** `grep 'Reference .* undefined\|multiply defined\|Undefined control sequence' Specification/fortress/fortress.log | sort | uniq -c` printed ``41 x@warning {Reference `#1' on page \thepage \space undefined}}{}``: the body of LaTeX's `\@setref`, as `\ZREF@refused` expands it, echoed by the macro tracing that `Specification/basic-lib/objects.tex:17` turns on (`\tracingcommands=1\tracingmacros=1`). It names no passage. The log holds no warning of either kind: `grep -c '^LaTeX Warning: Reference'`, `grep -c 'multiply defined'` and `grep -c 'There were undefined references\|There were multiply-defined labels'` print 0, and its one line opening `! ` is a traced expansion. Climb batches 16, 17 and 18's repairs read the same lines so (42 there; `explorations/compile-ladder/climb-batch-17/REPAIR-review.md`, section 2, deviation 2; `explorations/compile-ladder/climb-batch-18/REPAIR-review.md`, "The specification's build"), as did rung P (`explorations/compile-ladder/rung-existential-reduction/REPORT.md:179`).
2. **Step 8's paths.** Beside the ruling's list (`Specification/appendices/changes.tex`, `explorations/compile-ladder/climb-batch-19/RECORD.md`, `explorations/coordinator/FACTS.md`, `explorations/coordinator/FACTS-history.md`), the commit carries this file, which the repair's brief asks for when an instruction meets a primary source, and which `RECORD.md`'s corrections cite.
